title: Etihad Stadium: overview
d: Etihad Stadium in Manchester, England: capacity about 53,400, opened 2002.
definition: Etihad Stadium in Manchester, England: capacity about 53,400, opened 2002.
description: Etihad Stadium stands in Manchester, England: a 53,400-capacity venue opened in 2002, home to Manchester City. From Commonwealth Games to dominance. Stadiums are the cathedrals of sport — concrete memory banks where generations experienced the same joys and heartbreaks. This database covers the ground's history, architecture, great events, and how to visit it.

title: History
d: Etihad Stadium opened in 2002. From Commonwealth Games to dominance..
definition: Etihad Stadium opened in 2002. From Commonwealth Games to dominance..
description: The history of Etihad Stadium begins in 2002. From Commonwealth Games to dominance. Like all great grounds, it has been rebuilt, renamed, and reborn — stands rising where terraces stood, roofs arriving decades after the first kick. Its timeline is the timeline of its tenants' triumphs and the city's love affair with the game.

title: Architecture
d: Etihad Stadium holds about 53,400 spectators in its current configuration.
definition: Etihad Stadium holds about 53,400 spectators in its current configuration.
description: The architecture of Etihad Stadium: a 53,400-capacity bowl designed to trap noise and frame the action. Great stadium design balances sightlines, acoustics, and atmosphere — the steepest stands feel closest, the roofs hold the roar in. Renovations keep adding hospitality while trying not to dilute the soul.

title: The tenants
d: Etihad Stadium is home to Manchester City.
definition: Etihad Stadium is home to Manchester City.
description: Etihad Stadium belongs to Manchester City — and to the fans who fill it. The tenant-club bond defines the ground's identity: the songs, the rituals, the expectation. When the team thrives the stadium shakes; when it struggles the old ground groans with it. You cannot separate the venue from its people.

title: Great matches
d: The greatest nights at Etihad Stadium live in legend.
definition: The greatest nights at Etihad Stadium live in legend.
description: The great nights at Etihad Stadium: title deciders, cup finals, impossible comebacks — the matches fans describe decades later as if they were yesterday. From Commonwealth Games to dominance. Every old ground has a canon of such nights, and they are why the place matters: the stadium is the stage, but the drama is the point.

title: Finals hosted
d: Etihad Stadium has hosted major finals and showpiece events.
definition: Etihad Stadium has hosted major finals and showpiece events.
description: Showpiece events at Etihad Stadium: cup finals, international tournaments, and one-off spectacles that put the ground on the world stage. Hosting a final is a civic honor — the city dresses up, the world watches, and the stadium joins the short list of venues that have seen it all.

title: Concerts and events
d: Etihad Stadium doubles as a concert and event venue.
definition: Etihad Stadium doubles as a concert and event venue.
description: Beyond sport, Etihad Stadium hosts concerts, ceremonies, and mega-events — the biggest stages need the biggest rooms. The ground's event history reads like pop culture itself. Multi-use keeps the economics working, though purists always prefer the roar of a matchday to anything else.

title: Visiting guide
d: Visit Etihad Stadium: tours, matchdays, and practical tips.
definition: Visit Etihad Stadium: tours, matchdays, and practical tips.
description: Visiting Etihad Stadium: stadium tours run most days, taking in the dressing rooms, the tunnel, and the dugout — book ahead in season. On matchdays arrive early, learn the songs, and respect the home ends. Manchester, England is best reached by public transport; driving on event days is for the patient.

title: Best seats
d: Where to sit at Etihad Stadium for atmosphere, view, or value.
definition: Where to sit at Etihad Stadium for atmosphere, view, or value.
description: Seats at Etihad Stadium: behind the goal for the songs, halfway up the side for the tactical view, high corners for value. The famous ends have waiting lists measured in years; the family sections trade noise for comfort. Wherever you sit, the rule is the same — arrive early, stay late.

title: Attendance records
d: Etihad Stadium's biggest crowds and what drew them.
definition: Etihad Stadium's biggest crowds and what drew them.
description: The biggest crowds at Etihad Stadium came for the biggest occasions — derbies, finals, and farewell games. From Commonwealth Games to dominance. Capacity has changed with all-seater conversions and expansions, so records from different eras are not directly comparable. What endures is the noise: full houses here are famously loud.

title: Fan culture
d: The songs and rituals of Etihad Stadium.
definition: The songs and rituals of Etihad Stadium.
description: Fan culture at Etihad Stadium: the anthems sung before kickoff, the scarves held high, the rituals passed down generations. Manchester City Every ground has its liturgy, and newcomers are expected to learn it. The culture is the point — the match is just the excuse for twenty thousand people to feel one thing together.

title: Derbies
d: Derby days at Etihad Stadium are the season's peak.
definition: Derby days at Etihad Stadium are the season's peak.
description: Derby days at Etihad Stadium divide the city: colors everywhere, nerves from dawn, and an atmosphere that visiting players never forget. Form goes out the window; pride decides it. Manchester City Win the derby and the season is saved — lose it, and the bragging rights belong to the other half of Manchester.
